title: VipMembershipChangedPayload
description: vip.membership.changed v1 (OpenVibe.VIP server/domain/entitlements.js emitChanged). A member's standing with a creator changed as projected from Billing (granted, renewed, cancel scheduled, expired, refunded…): active, expires_at or cancel_at_period_end differ from before, or a first look found an active membership. Names the plan version the membership was bought under. Envelope: subject { type: membership, id: <member usr_…>:<creator usr_…> }, visibility internal, priority important, actor service:vip.

previous.description: The projection before the change; null on first sight.

reason.description: Billing's reason (granted, renewed, refund, expired…) or VIP's (checked, cancel_scheduled).

billing_event_id.description: The Billing event (evt_…) behind the change, when it came from one.
